foundation: (Positional mean PIM/game minus player PIM/game) divided by positional population standard deviation.
drawingBonus: Coefficient multiplied by max(0, standardized penalties drawn/game). No below-average deduction.
comparisonGroup: Same season and NHL position; minimum five-on-five eligibility. Each eligible player equally weighted.
netPenalties: Display context only; no index contribution.
missingDataPolicy: Below-cutoff seasons remain unscored. Invalid eligible scoring inputs fail the run.
historicalAggregation: Equal average of unrounded eligible season indices within the configured historical window.
historicalComparisonGroup: Latest recorded NHL position within the window; players with at least one eligible season.
percentileMethod: 100 * (players below + half the players tied) / comparison group size.
ratingMethod: Percentile divided by 10, rounded to one decimal. Unrated remains distinct from zero.
note: Provisional descriptive discipline ratings. Grading uses the same shared helpers as offense and defense. A rounded 10.0 does not indicate perfection. Penalty statistics do not equal power-play opportunities. No overall-player contribution has been assigned.
